title: 第20章 斩鼠王获丹师遗物第21章 火炁炼丹术
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
李安之前吸收了白虎精魄，对自己的帮助很大。
这些火尾鼠的精魄若是可以多吸收一些，灵魂之力必然再度有所提升，说不定可以以战养战！
这些其实早就在李安的算计当中。
所以这个时候就必须控制住银蛇这个不稳定因素。
银蛇不知道李安的功法，只觉得他太过自信了！
尽管这些火尾鼠的个体实力不强，可它们却像是一个个小火球，自爆之后，威能还是相当可怕。
不过它也不着急，等到李安在这些火尾鼠手中吃了苦头，他自然会让自己兵分两路，然后对火尾鼠动手。
砰砰！
然而，它心中刚一生出这个想法，李安已经催动体内的灵气，施展各种基础的法诀。
剑雨术！
火球术！
他是五行灵根，也就意味着他可以施展各种术法，没有任何的限制，尽管这些法诀因为时间的关系，还都只修炼到入门，连小成都还没达到！
但李安如今的根基极为深厚，此番出手，对付的又是大多连炼气一层都还没到的不入流火尾鼠，简直就是虎入羊群。
完全就是单方面的屠杀！
而在抹杀了那些火尾鼠后，李安双手掐诀，将灵魄决催动到极致，吸收空气中那如萤火虫般即将飘散的妖兽精魄。
这些妖兽精魄极为稀少，还非常容易飘散。
可是李安的功法特殊，刚好对这些妖兽精魄有克制作用，纷纷汇聚到他身上，使得他犹如众星捧月般耀眼。
有如此浩瀚的妖兽精魄加持的，李安的境界也是有了更进一步的迹象。
催动法诀消耗的灵气，也是在那源源不断的精魄加持下，迅速恢复过来。

于是，李安在灵魄决这特殊的功法加持下，越战越勇！
脚下很快就堆满了火尾鼠的尸体，空气中弥漫着一股刺鼻的血腥味。
原本对李安极为不屑的火尾鼠鼠王，也是神色凝重起来。
火尾鼠成群结队一起上，可不是那么容易对付的。
可现在，给它的感觉，怎么反倒是成为了李安这个人族的养料？
因为在它的感知中，李安刚刚进入到洞窟的时候，气息似乎是最孱弱的时候，之后迅速暴涨！
以至于就是它都从李安身上，逐渐嗅到了一丝危险的味道。
不行！
不能让李安这么继续下去！
火尾鼠鼠王怒吼一声，然后身上就有一股特殊的血脉波动散发而出。
凡是感知到这股血脉波动的火尾鼠，立刻毫不犹豫地将体内微薄的灵气，汇聚到火尾鼠王体内。
“这里是我妖族的地盘，你们人族实在太不讲规矩了！”
鼠王暴怒地盯着李安。
有了这些火尾鼠源源不断力量加持，鼠王的实力也是来到了炼气四层巅峰，接近炼气五层！
特别是在众多妖兽加持下，它那一双火红色的大尾巴，更是散发出极为炙热的高温。
就像是熔岩一般，让人不敢靠近。
在李安胸口的银蛇，此时已经完全呆住了。
content_en:
;;
Li An absorbed the white tiger essence before, which helped him a lot.
If the essence of these fire-tailed rats can be absorbed more, the power of the soul will definitely increase again, and maybe it can be used to support war!
These have actually been part of Ang Lee's calculations for a long time.
Therefore, at this time, the unstable factor of Silver Snake must be controlled.
Silver Snake didn't know Li An's skills, she just felt that he was too confident!
Although the individual strength of these fire-tailed rats is not strong, they are like small fireballs. After they explode, their power is still quite terrifying.
But it is not in a hurry. When Li An suffers at the hands of these fire-tailed rats, he will naturally divide his troops into two groups and then attack the fire-tailed rats.
Bang bang!
However, as soon as this idea came into its mind, Li An had already activated the spiritual energy in his body and used various basic techniques.
Sword Rain Technique!
Fireball!
He has the Five Elements Spiritual Root, which means that he can perform various spells without any restrictions. Although these spells have only been practiced to the entry level due to time constraints, and have not even reached Xiaocheng!
But Li An's foundation is extremely deep now. This time, he was dealing with low-level fire-tailed rats, most of whom had not even reached the first level of Qi refining. It was like a tiger among sheep.
It was a complete one-sided massacre!
After wiping out those fire-tailed rats, Li An made a secret with both hands, pushing the Soul Art to the extreme to absorb the demonic beast essence that was about to float away like fireflies in the air.
These monster spirits are extremely rare and easily dispersed.
However, Li An's special skills happened to have a restraining effect on these monster spirits, and they all converged on him, making him as dazzling as the stars holding the moon.
With the blessing of such vast monster spirits, Li An also showed signs of further advancement.
The spiritual energy consumed in activating the magic formula was quickly recovered under the continuous blessing of the essence.
Therefore, with the blessing of the special skill of Lingso Jue, Li An became more and more courageous as he fought!
The corpses of fire-tailed rats were soon piled up at their feet, and the air was filled with a pungent smell of blood.
The Fire-tailed Mouse King, who was originally extremely disdainful of Li An, also looked serious.
Fire-tailed rats come in groups and are not easy to deal with.
But now, how come it feels like it has become nourishment for Li An, a human race?
Because according to its perception, Li An's aura seemed to be at its weakest when he first entered the cave, and then rapidly increased!
So much so that even it gradually smelled a hint of danger from Li An.
no!
Ang Lee cannot be allowed to continue like this!
The Fire-Tailed Rat King roared angrily, and then a special blood wave emanated from his body.
Any fire-tailed rat that senses this bloodline fluctuation immediately gathers the meager spiritual energy in its body into the body of the Fire-tailed Rat King without hesitation.
"This is the territory of my demon clan. You humans are too unruly!"
The Rat King stared at Li An angrily.
With the continuous power blessing of these fire-tailed rats, the strength of the Rat King has also reached the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining, approaching the fifth level of Qi Refining!
Especially with the blessing of many monster beasts, its pair of fiery red big tails are emitting extremely hot temperatures.
It's like lava, making people afraid to get close.
The silver snake on Li An's chest was completely stunned at this time.
